string.SelectPlanToBegin: Select a plan below to get started
string.UpgradeDescription: You will be charged up to {amount} {currency} immediately. The exact amount depends on your current billing period.
string.DowngradeDescription: You will receive a credit of up to {amount} {currency} for the remaining subscription time. The downgrade takes effect immediately.
string.DowngradeToFreeDescription: Your paid subscription will end immediately and the workspace will switch to the free plan. No refund is issued for the remaining period.
string.CancelDescription: Your subscription will remain active until the end of the billing period.
string.UncancelDescription: Your subscription will be reactivated and continue from the end of the current billing period.
string.ConfirmCancelPackageDescription: Your package subscription will remain active until the end of the paid period.
string.LimitReached: Workspace limit reached, some functionality may be disabled. Upgrade to restore full access.
string.RestrictedPlans: Only the workspace owner or billing manager can change the subscription plan
string.SubscriptionErrorMessage: Something went wrong. Please try again or contact support.
string.OtherCheckoutActiveTitle: A payment is already in progress
string.OtherCheckoutActiveMessage: A payment for a different plan is already in progress for this workspace. You can cancel it and switch to the plan you just chose, or wait for it to complete (the pending payment expires within 15 minutes).
string.OtherCheckoutActiveTooltip: A payment is in progress by another member of this workspace. Please wait for it to complete.
string.CheckoutAlreadyPaidMessage: The pending payment was completed while switching, so the plan it was for is now active. Review your subscription before choosing another plan.
string.UpgradeToAccessPackages: Upgrade to Standard or Business to access additional packages
string.PaymentFailedDescription: We will retry automatically. You can also try again manually.
string.RetriesExhaustedDescription: Please contact support to resolve payment issues.
string.PaymentOverdueReadonly: Payment is overdue. The workspace is in read-only mode.
string.SeatLimitReadonly: Seat limit reached. Your account is in read-only mode.
string.FreePlanHint: Payment is overdue — the workspace runs on the free plan. Pay to restore your plan.
string.TrialPlanHint: Business trial — {days} days left. Buy the plan to keep your features after it ends.
